key_impacts: At least five million people affected
Hospitals and health centres destroyed or damaged
Water and sanitation systems disrupted and contaminated
evidence_snippets: On 26 December 2004 a massive earthquake west of northern Sumatra triggered a powerful tsunami.
At least five million people were affected; the death toll exceeded 280,000.
In Banda Aceh, Indonesia, some 200,000 homes have been sprayed with insecticide.
missing_information: Granular sub-national locations outside Indonesia not specified
